Senses.PreferredTarget: a tortoise boring through a wall

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: A tortoise boring through a wall is comically slow force accomplishing an impossible breach. Chan masters give it after long-duration or “today’s affair” questions, yet also say that even sorting out the presented scene may amount only to this laborious breakthrough.
EvidenceBody: Sanyi Yu says that even correctly sorting the rainy-day scene is a tortoise boring through the wall.
Changqing Huileng answers “what is today’s affair?” with the phrase after asking what differs across immeasurable ages.
Yunfeng Wenyue preserves the same duration-and-today formula in a separate record.
Sanyi Yu later gives the phrase after a respondent asks him to return to the quarters.

Senses.Note: Twenty-eight exact hits occur in twenty-two frozen works. Four witnesses preserve answer, appraisal, and separate live exchange.
